canonical.title: Number of Provinces
canonical.sourceFilePath: 13. Graphs/2. Traversal Problems/01. Count the number of provinces.cpp

narrative.title: Counting the Connected Depot Clusters
narrative.scenario: A courier network's control room keeps an n x n handshake table: row i, column j shows whether depot i can hand parcels directly to depot j. Two depots belong to the same cluster when a chain of handshakes — however long — links them. Dispatch needs the number of separate clusters, because each cluster needs its own coordinator.
narrative.inputFormat: An n x n binary matrix isConnected where isConnected[i][j] is 1 if depot i and depot j are directly linked.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the number of connected clusters (provinces).

testCases.explanation: Depots 0 and 1 shake hands with each other; depot 2 stands alone.
No cross-links at all — every depot is its own province.

hintLevels: Level 1: Each unvisited depot opens a new cluster; sweep the whole roster to catch every one.
Level 2: One DFS from any depot claims its entire chain of handshakes as visited.
Level 3: The matrix is just an adjacency structure — walking it row by row avoids building a second copy.
